description: This file contains unit tests for the membership table snapshot functionality in an Orleans-based distributed system. It tests scenarios like retrieving silo status, handling unknown silos, and preserving IAmAliveTime during snapshot updates.

classes.name: MembershipTableSnapshotTests
classes.description: Contains test methods for verifying the behavior of membership table snapshots, including silo status retrieval and IAmAliveTime preservation.

methods.name: MembershipTableSnapshot_GetSiloStatus_JoiningSilo
methods.description: Tests retrieving the status of a silo that is in 'Joining' state.

methods.name: MembershipTableSnapshot_GetSiloStatus_StoppingSilo
methods.description: Tests that the status in the entry object overrides the value in the table for a stopping silo.

methods.name: MembershipTableSnapshot_GetSiloStatus_UnknownSilo
methods.description: Tests retrieving the status of a silo not present in the snapshot, expecting 'None'.

methods.name: MembershipTableSnapshot_CreateUpdatePreservesIAmAliveTime
methods.description: Verifies that updating a snapshot preserves the most recent IAmAliveTime.

methods.name: MembershipTableSnapshot_GetSiloStatus_UnknownSilo_KnownSuccessor
methods.description: Tests that an unknown silo is considered dead if a known successor exists.

methods.name: Silo
methods.description: Helper method to create a SiloAddress from string.

methods.name: Entry
methods.description: Helper method to create a MembershipEntry with specified parameters.

methods.name: Table
methods.description: Helper method to create MembershipTableData from entries.

methods.name: AddOrUpdateEntry
methods.description: Helper method to add or update an entry in a snapshot.
